summary: Voters in Hasanpur town mostly complain about long power cuts that also hit drinking water, stray dogs attacking children, open drains on main roads and potholed roads, while the main appreciation is the Ganga Expressway passing through the area; no voter praise was found.

positives.english: The Ganga Expressway passing through our area is a big thing
positives.hindi: हमारे इलाके से गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे गुजरा, यह बड़ी बात है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 30 Apr 2026, reporting the PM's inauguration of the 594 km expressway in Hardoi): Hasanpur MLA Mahendra Singh Khadgavanshi said the expressway passing from here is a matter of good fortune for the area. This is the MLA's statement, not a voter's; no voter praise was found.

positives.english: An unregistered clinic in Hasanpur has been sealed
positives.hindi: बिना रजिस्ट्रेशन चल रहा क्लीनिक सील हुआ
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Moradabad Bureau, dateline Hasanpur, 7 Oct 2026): a health team sealed New Family Health Care Centre on Rahra Road for running without registration, and issued a notice (no sealing yet, children admitted) to Saloni Baal Clinic on the same road. The inspection followed complaints; the article does not say who complained. An enforcement action, not a voter's view.

positives.english: *Seven roads worth about Rs 10 crore in the Hasanpur area have been approved
positives.hindi: *हसनपुर में 10 करोड़ की सात सड़कें मंजूर हुई हैं
positives.basis: Inference: approval only. Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 26 Aug 2026): about Rs 10 crore approved for seven roads (Agrola Kala crossroads to Fattehpur, Sohraka to Allipur Milak, and five others), on MLA Mahendra Khadgavanshi's proposal. The article uses future tense and does not say any road has started or finished. No voter view found; field check needed.

positives.english: *Repair of three roads in the Hasanpur area has been approved and tendering has started
positives.hindi: *हसनपुर क्षेत्र की तीन सड़कों की मरम्मत मंजूर हुई है
positives.basis: Inference: approval and tendering only. Amar Ujala (Amroha, 11 Sep 2026): PWD approved repair of nine roads in the district, three of them in the Hasanpur area (Sambhal-Dayarsi to Pandika crossing, Rahra-Gaya to Dehri Khadar, Aitmali to Kasaipura). The article says tendering has started but no repair work is reported, and the PWD XEN said work would finish in 30 days if it does not rain. Weak positive; field check needed.

positives.english: *Basic first treatment is available at the Hasanpur CHC
positives.hindi: *सीएचसी में पहला इलाज मिल जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 19 Jun 2026) shows the community health centre gave an injured child first aid and referred him to the district hospital. No resident praised the CHC and no later report was found. Weakest positive; field check needed.

negatives.english: Power was cut for 10 hours in Hasanpur and drinking water also became a problem
negatives.hindi: 10 घंटे बिजली बंद रही, पीने के पानी तक की दिक्कत हुई
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 13 Apr 2026): supply was cut from about 9 AM to about 7:45 PM on 12 Apr 2026 for replacing a VCB at the 33/11 kV Hasanpur Town substation. The report says the lack of power caused drinking-water problems. Residents are not quoted. AC membership: the substation serves Hasanpur town, the AC's namesake; no source found lists the AC extent, so this is taken from the namesake only.

negatives.english: Stray dogs are attacking children and no action is taken even after complaints
negatives.hindi: आवारा कुत्ते बच्चों को काट रहे हैं, शिकायत पर कार्रवाई नहीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 19 Jun 2026), Abdullah Colony on Sambhal Road: a pack of stray dogs mauled a 7-year-old deaf-mute boy on Thursday night. Residents said stray dogs had attacked three children in four months and that written and verbal complaints to the nagar palika had led to no action. These are residents' allegations as reported.

negatives.english: Open drains in Hasanpur town have people falling in and getting hurt, and the municipality is not serious
negatives.hindi: खुले नालों में गिरकर लोग घायल, नगर पालिका गंभीर नहीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 16 Jul 2026): deep open drains on main roads and in dense mohallas, named spots HS Public School road, Rahra Adda to Sambhal Adda, Ambedkar Chowk to hospital road and the truck union bypass. Two- and four-wheeler riders fell in at night and were hurt; residents say there have been earlier deaths and accuse the municipality of not being serious. Municipal board chairman Rajpal Saini said barricading of open drains will start soon, with no timeline. Residents' allegations as reported.

negatives.english: The sugarcane payment is stuck and crores of rupees are still owed
negatives.hindi: गन्ने के करोड़ों रुपये बकाया हैं, भुगतान अटका पड़ा है
negatives.basis: District-level, not Hasanpur-specific: Amar Ujala (Amroha, 27 Jul 2026) says three mills owe Rs 44.67 crore in total: Web Sugar Mill Dhanaura over Rs 39 crore, Rana Sugar Mill Belwara about Rs 4 crore, Karimganj Sugar Mill Shahabad Rs 1.67 crore. Hasanpur mill is named only among the ten mills Amroha farmers supply, not among those with dues.

negatives.english: The Hasanpur to Rahra road has deep potholes and is hard to use in the rain
negatives.hindi: हसनपुर-राहरा रोड पर गहरे गड्ढे, बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (Moradabad Bureau, 2 Oct 2026): after two days of rain, the Hasanpur-Rahra road has deep potholes, worst near Rustampur Khadar; two-wheeler riders slip and get injured. The Hasanpur end is in the AC town; whether Rustampur Khadar and Rahra lie inside the AC is not confirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific. The same article's jam report refers to Amroha city roads, not this road.

notes: Thin local evidence: positives 3, 4 and 5 are inferences (approval-only or a weak first-aid report), and the sourced positives are an MLA's statement and an enforcement action. AC extent is not confirmed: the Wikipedia AC page, the amroha.nic.in constituency page and the Hindi Wikipedia AC page list no tehsils, blocks, villages or areas. Hasanpur town is the AC's namesake and the dateline of negatives 1-3; this is counted as AC-specific but no source states the town's AC membership. Rukhalu (Univarta 8 Oct 2026, Amrit Vichar 21 May 2025) was dropped: both place it in Hasanpur tehsil, which is not the AC; the 26 Aug 2026 Amar Ujala expressway article also names Rukhalu only in the 'Hasanpur area' list. Ganga Expressway: the 26 Aug 2026 Amar Ujala article says the expressway starts at the Mangrola T-point and that 52 villages of Hasanpur and Mandi Dhanaura tehsils are in the project scope; it does not give Mangrola's tehsil or AC. Mangrola's toll plaza is mentioned in Amar Ujala (4 May 2026) with no AC link. Membership of the Hasanpur expressway stretch and of Mangrola is unconfirmed. Hasanpur industrial park: Amar Ujala (4 May 2026, Hasanpur dateline) reports about 2,200 bigha for an industrial corridor, about 65% acquired, with no factories named and no village named. Not used as a positive (no delivered benefit, location unconfirmed). A 120-hectare park claim seen in search snippets was not fetched and is not used. Dropped positives: the cane-survey item (the source reports 88 teams to demonstrate the survey, not village-level corrections) and the advance-notice item (the source gives no direct SDO quote). Rahra AC membership and Rustampur Khadar AC membership remain unconfirmed. Field check needed: power supply, stray dogs, open drains, the Hasanpur-Rahra road, and whether the approved road works have started.

round2.changes: Verified all 9 remaining URLs by fetch. Removed the cane-survey positive (claim not in source), Rukhalu negative (AC unconfirmed) and its 2 sources (Univarta, Amrit Vichar). Replaced the MLA-statement-only positive with a sealed unregistered clinic (kept Ganga Expressway as P1 with the MLA caveat). Added inference approvals of 7 roads and 3 repairs. Added open-drains negative (Hasanpur town, Amar Ujala 16 Jul 2026, sourced). Corrected the power-cut basis (no direct SDO quote). Corrected the potholes basis (jams refer to city roads). Corrected the 'Hasanpur town AC membership' wording. Ranked: P1 expressway, P2 clinic, P3-P5 inferences. Negatives: power, dogs, open drains, cane dues (district), potholes.
